subject.title: Feature: Processing indicator message for Telegram (send ⌛️ while thinking, delete on reply)

question: Should Telegram add a standalone processing-message lifecycle, or should typing and phased reactions remain the complete supported presence UX?
rationale: The transport can implement the request, but choosing another visible feedback mode and its permanent timing, cleanup, failure, and configuration semantics requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Add delayed placeholder
options.body: Add an opt-in Telegram-owned placeholder after a short delay, with deletion after successful final delivery and concise failure handling.

options.title: Standardize reactions
options.body: Use typing plus acknowledgment and phased reactions as the complete Telegram presence model.

options.title: Unify acknowledgment text
options.body: Resolve the broader cross-channel contract at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/8285 before adding Telegram-specific configuration.

recommendation.title: Add delayed placeholder
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in Telegram-owned placeholder after a short delay, with deletion after successful final delivery and concise failure handling.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent Telegram architecture history and already supplied the most detailed review of this product boundary.
